name: Closing name card with an open-to-work note
looks: A two-line title settles ("MOTION DESIGNER", bigger name beneath with an accent dot), a small hand-written line curling in underneath on its own thin connector stating availability, the HUD timeline bar running along the bottom with a final labelled marker.
build: Title lines arrive together (`y:10px -> 0`, power2.out, ~300ms), the accent dot popping in last at the name's end. The hand-written availability line draws on with a short curling connector stroke from the dot, in a script face distinct from the display type. The timeline bar's final marker is labelled and sits furthest right.
sound: A soft low swell under the title's arrival, a light pen-scratch sound under the hand-written line.
prompt: Close on a two-line name card, a role label above a bigger name with an accent dot at its end, then draw a short hand-written line curling in from that dot stating availability, with a labelled HUD timeline marker at the very end of the bar along the bottom to mark the reel's close.
